clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper seeks corrupted brain stems from Blackfathom Deeps. Reports say blood elves across the sea are turning to demonic magic, and he hopes to learn from the naga and satyr before history repeats itself.

The ruin of their ancient kin remains a living memory to night elves across Kalimdor. Ten thousand years ago, the Highborne gave in to demonic energies and became horned satyrs or serpentine naga. Now the high elves call themselves blood elves and embrace dark magic. Gershala Nightwhisper sees the old disaster taking shape again.

Blackfathom Deeps offers Gershala a place to study the corruption. The temple ruins lie beneath the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, where satyr cultists and naga dwell. He asks you to gather brain stems from both, hoping to trace the link between arcane addiction, demonic corruption, and the ruin of the body.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?
I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.
I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.
Perhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have traveled far and undoubtedly faced great peril.
Your actions have been selfless. 'Tis for the good of all Azeroth that you help me with my research. I thank you, friend, for all that you have done.
Now if you'll excuse me I have much work to do....
